But just one did it in a single year. 🏆⛳ In this powerful golf documentary, we break down golf’s hardest achievement — the legendary Grand Slam: ✅ Bobby Jones' 1930 calendar-year Grand Slam — still unmatched ✅ Modern Grand Slam: The Masters, PGA Championship, U.S. Open, and The Open ✅ Tiger Woods' “Tiger Slam” — four straight majors, but not in one year ✅ Phil Mickelson’s near-miss — six-time U.S. Open runner-up ✅ Rory McIlroy’s redemption — winning the 2025 Masters for a career Grand Slam The Grand Slam is golf’s most elusive goal — a true test of greatness, consistency, and history-making talent.
